summary:
Updated LPG Manager Implementation Plan with strictly English terminology, high-contrast dark theme visual guidelines (#FFFFFF headings, #94A3B8 subtitles), and complete architectural specifications for:
- End-of-Day (EOD) Staff Cash & Empty Reconciliation
- Defective / Leaking Cylinder Tracker & Bottling Plant Warranty Dispatch
- 19 KG Commercial Customer Ledger for bulk credit & rolling empty tracking
- One-Click EOD Summary Report generation with WhatsApp share and print preview
- Updated Firestore schemas, security rules, and modular project directory.
